source.message_reference: User follow-up item 9 authorizes maturity-based weighting framework

input_map.normalization: Excel serial 45626 interpreted as 2024-11-30 from workbook label/context.

plug_ins.missing_input: Exact AY Chain Ladder/BF blend weights were not specified.
plug_ins.unit_basis: Decimal method weights by AY; sum to 1.0 for every AY.
plug_ins.justification: User authorized a framework that gives more BF weight to immature recent years and more Chain Ladder weight to mature years. A transparent percent-reported bucket rule was selected.
plug_ins.limitation: The bucket cutoffs and weights are judgmental rather than statistically optimized; different actuarial credibility selections would change the recommended loss ratio.

key_results.metric: Aggregate Chain Ladder adjusted loss ratio

limitations: Annual rate changes do not have exact effective dates, so the user-selected annual uniform approximation is used rather than an exact parallelogram.
The CL/BF blend weights are a disclosed judgmental maturity rule, not a credibility model.
A 1.005 tail is user-selected and tail uncertainty is not quantified.
